# PayoutDelta // Institutional Settlement Ledger
> Real-time foreign exchange spread benchmarks, SWIFT intermediary cut deductions, and statutory export tax treaties.

- Base URL: https://ahmadbilaldsa.github.io/payout-delta
- Canonical Repository: https://github.com/AhmadBilalDSA/payout-delta
- Architecture: 100% Client-Side Static Export (Next.js 15, zero tracking, zero runtime backend)
- Core API Feeds: /api/fees.json, /api/banksRegistry.json, /api/jurisdictions.json
- Supported Corridors: USD to PKR, BDT, INR, NGN, PHP, EUR, GBP
